# Code of conduct

changemylocation is a small project, and everyone who uses it, reports bugs or contributes should feel welcome here.

## Be good to each other

- Be respectful and patient, especially with people who are new to iPhones, GitHub or coding.
- Keep feedback about the work, not the person.
- Assume good intent, and ask before you assume.

## Not okay

- Harassment, insults, slurs or personal attacks.
- Sharing someone's private information, including their real location.
- Spam, advertising, or posting links to paid spoofing tools.
- Asking for help using the app to stalk, track or mislead someone.

## Reporting

If someone breaks these rules, use GitHub's **Report content** option on the comment, issue or discussion, or [report the user to GitHub](https://docs.github.com/en/communities/maintaining-your-safety-on-github/reporting-abuse-or-spam). The maintainer can also see and act on anything posted in this repository.

## What happens

The maintainer may edit or remove comments, lock conversations, or block people from the project, depending on how serious it is. These rules apply in issues, discussions, pull requests and anywhere else you represent the project.
